description: Expected known-item rank-1 for every chunk, using each chunk's own text and committed embedding as the query, under the final quantised retriever (dense arm rounded to 4 decimals, BM25 and fused unrounded, chunk-id tie-break). Exact-equality fixture: the test asserts every observed rank-1 equals expected_rank1, row for row. Categories document the resolution and carry no logic; the only categorical assertion is that no row is a dissimilar rank-1. cosine and the won_by flags are diagnostic and decide nothing.

category_definitions.raw_verbatim_twin: rank-1 is a byte-identical different chunk
category_definitions.near_duplicate: rank-1 differs under normalisation, a genuine near-duplicate pinned as a pair

won_by_definitions.genuine_preference: true iff rank-1 outscored the query's own chunk in at least one arm; the meaningful flag
won_by_definitions.won_by_fused: strict iff rank-1's fused score exceeds the own chunk's, else tie_break; mechanical companion, mostly the within-arm tie-break propagating

genuine_preference_decomposition.note: every genuine preference is a shorter near-duplicate winning BM25 on length-normalised density, dBM25 positive and dDense negative; the b=0.75 length bias behaving as predicted
